method: Up to 3 addresses per registered municipality (known live-test addresses first, then Geonorge samples), through the bundled Worker in workerd. Verified means a named calendar with unique municipality-specific UIDs and at least one current or future collection date. A sample does not prove every address works. Registry absence is not proof of no Norkart data.
